column1: # Build concessions: bytes the pinned compiler cannot produce from any source form we have found, written into the
# compiled object after compiling (tools/decomp.py apply_object_patches). Each row names the source, the function
# symbol, the byte offset inside that function, the bytes expected there (with context) and their replacement; the
# build stops if the expected bytes are not exactly there, so a source change can never leave a stale patch applied.
# Every row is a concession, described in its REASON. Only decomp.py's own commands (check, score, diff, build) apply them;
# every other caller of build() measures the natural compiler output.
# TAB-separated: SOURCE SYMBOL OFFSET EXPECTED REPLACEMENT REASON
